0.content: The Lan clan is an ancient Liyue clan of thaumaturges based in Chenyu Vale. According to Lan Yu, it descends from the older and younger brothers of the Wind Reader, Lan Junming, who remained unmarried. The Wind Reader taught the family the Qimen Arts and would not force a clan member to study nor turn away an outsider who sincerely wished to learn. The clan works through duty or hobby, and sometimes through rattan figures, a craft Lan Yan is known for.
